01.en: Face of fist uneven; The thumb is not pressing on the second segment of both the index and middle fingers
01.zh: 拳面不平；拇指未压在食指和中指第二指节上

02.en: Four fingers not straight and held together; Thumb is not bent and held in tightly; Five fingers not separated with the first and second segment of each finger not hooked and flexed; Center of the palm not pushed out
02.zh: 四指未伸直并拢；拇指未弯曲紧扣于虎口处；五指未弯曲分开后张；掌心未凸出

03.en: The five fingers are not pinched together; Wrist not hooked completely; Five Fingers not pinched together; Wrist flexed (bent) when striking
03.zh: 五指未捏拢；腕未屈；五指未捏拢；屈腕

04.en: Index finger and middle finger not kept straight and together; Thumb not pressing on the ring finger and little finger; Index finger not Straight; The other 4 fingers not tightly bent/hooked
04.zh: 食指与中指未伸直并拢；拇指未压在无名指与小指上；食指未伸直；其余四指未弯曲扣紧

05.en: Elbow lifted; Arm straightened; Armpit closed

06.en: Head and body not aligned; Shoulders hunched, rounded lower back, buttocks sticking out; Shoulders shrugged; Waist twisted
06.zh: 头、身不正；驼背弓腰突臀；耸肩；扭腰摆臀

10.en: Supporting Leg Bent; Raised Leg Bent
10.zh: 支撑腿弯曲；上举腿弯曲

12.en: The raised leg is held below horizontal level

13.en: Supporting leg bent; The torso is below horizontal level
13.zh: 支撑腿弯曲；躯干低于水平

14.en: Thigh of supporting leg is not at horizontal level

15.en: Supporting leg bent; Raised leg bent
15.zh: 支撑腿弯曲；后举腿弯曲

16.en: Torso held 45° or more above horizontal level; Waist not twisted toward the rear in the direction of the supporting leg; Instep of the raised bent leg not extended flat
16.zh: 躯干高于水平45°或超过45°；未向支撑腿侧拧腰后视；屈收腿脚背未绷平

17.en: The heel of the supporting leg is raised; Kicking leg bent at knee; The foot of the kicking leg is not turned outwards
17.zh: 支撑腿脚跟离地；前腿膝部弯曲；脚尖未外展

18.en: Forward stretched leg bends and/or drops below horizontal level at any point during the transition from standing to squatting
18.zh: 屈蹲过程中前举腿弯曲或低于水平

19.en: The foot of the leg crossed behind the supporting leg makes contact with the ground

20.en: The thigh of supporting leg is above horizontal level; The sole of sweeping foot leaves the ground after making contact for the sweeping action; Sweeping leg bent 45° or more
20.zh: 支撑腿大腿高于水平；扫转腿脚掌在扫转时触地后离地；扫转腿弯曲45°或超过45°

21.en: The sole of sweeping foot leaves the ground after making contact for the sweeping action; Sweeping leg bent 45° or more
21.zh: 扫转腿脚掌离地；扫转腿弯曲45°或超过45°

22.en: The sole of the front foot turns inward and touches the ground; Front and rear legs did not form two parallel straight line; Front foot turns in and touches the ground; Angle between the two legs is 45° or less
22.zh: 前脚内扣触地；两腿未前后形成两条平行直线；前脚内扣触地；后腿两大腿夹角小于45°

23.en: The kicking leg does not transit from obvious bent (45° or more) to completely straight; The raised leg is below horizontal level; The raised leg is bent
23.zh: 弹（蹬、踹）腿由屈到伸摆动小于45°；上举腿低于水平；上举腿未伸直

24.en: Knee/s bent at the apex of the kick; Heel of supporting leg off the floor
24.zh: 膝关节弯曲；支撑腿脚跟离地

25.en: Toes of slapped foot not above shoulder height; Slap missed and/or inaudible; Kicking Leg Bent When Slapped; Kicking leg bent; Toes of the kicking leg not above waist level
25.zh: 击响腿脚尖未过肩；未击响；击响时摆动腿弯曲；后摆腿弯曲；后摆腿脚尖未过腰

26.en: Raised knee not above waist level; Raised shank/calf of the leg is not turning obliquely inwards; Raised foot's toes not pointed and hooking inwards
26.zh: 提膝未过腰；提起腿小腿未斜垂里扣；提起腿脚未崩平内收

27.en: The kicking leg does not transit from bent (angle less than 45°) to completely straight; The kicking leg does not travel horizontally across to the opposite side of the body; The toes of the kicking foot are not flexed inwards
27.zh: 摆动腿由屈至伸摆动小于45°；未用摆动腿前脚掌向异侧横向钉击；摆动腿脚尖未勾起

30.en: Toes of slapped foot not above shoulder level; Slap missed and/or inaudible
30.zh: 击响腿脚尖未过肩；未击响

31.en: The hanging leg is bend at the moment the toes of the kicking leg touches the forehead or above the forehead; The angle between the torso and the hanging leg is less than 135° the moment the toes of the kicking leg touches the forehead or above the forehead
31.zh: 踢腿脚触及或超过前额瞬间悬垂腿弯曲；踢腿脚触及或超过前额瞬间躯干与悬垂腿夹角小于135°

32.en: Leg/s bent 45° or more while in the air

33.en: Leg/s obviously bent 45° or more while in the air; Angle of the torso is 45° or more above horizontal level during the twist
33.zh: 空中腿弯曲45°或超过45°；转体时躯干高于水平45°或超过45°

34.en: Snap/Spring (pushing) leg does not transit from an obvious bent (45° or more) to completely straight; Snap/Spring (pushing) leg below horizontal level
34.zh: 弹（蹬）腿由屈到伸摆动小于45°；弹（蹬）出腿低于水平

40.en: Toes of the kicking leg not above head level

42.en: The legs are not held close together when kicked out and/or are obviously bent when kicked out

50.en: The knee of the front leg is not above the instep; The thigh of the bending (front) leg is not parallel to the ground; Any portion of the sole of the rear leg obviously off the floor; The rear foot is not hooked inwards with the toes pointing obliquely forwards
50.zh: 前腿膝部未达脚背；前腿大腿未达水平；后腿脚掌任一部位明显离地；后腿脚尖未内扣

51.en: Thighs not horizontal; The distance between the inner portions of the two feet is narrower than performer's shoulder width; Knee/s buckling inwards; The heel/s raised off the ground; Toes of foot/feet pointing outward 45° or more
51.zh: 大腿未达水平；两脚内侧间距小于本人肩宽；膝内跪；脚跟离地；脚尖外展45°或超过45°

52.en: Thigh of squatting leg is not parallel to the ground; The heel of supporting foot is raised off the ground; Knee and toes of supporting leg misaligned
52.zh: 屈蹲腿大腿未达水平；屈蹲腿脚跟离地；屈蹲腿膝与脚尖未对正

53.en: The back of the thigh of the squatting leg is not in contact with the calf; The extended leg is not completely straight; Extended leg's foot is not turned inwards with the sole completely flat on the ground
53.zh: 屈蹲腿未全蹲；平铺腿未伸直；平铺腿全脚掌未内扣着地

54.en: The two thighs are not crossed and closed together; The buttocks are not in contact with the calf of the sitting leg
54.zh: 两腿未交叉靠拢；臀部未贴坐小腿

55.en: The inner part of the shank/calf of the splayed leg/s is not fully in contact with the ground; The inner part of the ankle/heel of the splayed leg/s is not fully in contact with the ground
55.zh: 后腿小腿内侧未着地；后腿脚踝内侧未着地

56.en: The knee of the lower kneeling leg touches the ground; The buttock does not sit fully on the shank/calf of the lower kneeling leg
56.zh: 后腿膝部着地；臀部未坐在后腿小腿上

57.en: The thigh of the front leg is not held at a range from horizontal level to 45° (excluding 45°) above horizontal level; The knee of the back leg makes contact with the ground
57.zh: 前腿大腿高于水平45°或低于水平；后腿膝部着地

58.en: Neither one of the buttocks are in contact with the floor; Either one of the feet is not in contact with the floor
58.zh: 臀部未贴坐地面；脚离地

59.en: Knee and toes of supporting leg misaligned; Foot is dragged when stepping (excluding special techniques); Center of gravity moving/fluctuating up and down when stepping; Toes of the raised foot is above the ankle of the other leg when advancing
59.zh: 支撑腿膝与脚尖未对正；脚拖地（特殊动作要求除外）；移动时重心起伏；上步时抬起脚脚尖高于踝关节

60.en: Straight sword and forearm/wrist are aligned; No obvious vertical circle formed

61.en: Any finger wraps around the top of the hand guard and touches the edge of the blade

62.en: The back of the broadsword blade is not kept close to the body when wrapping or twining

63.en: Spear head not travelling in a clearly defined arc; Rear handle of spear end protruding from grip (extending past rear grip); The thrusting arm and the spear shaft do not form a straight line horizontally; Arm and fan are not aligned
63.zh: 拦、拿枪枪尖未明显划弧；后手留把；平扎枪臂与枪身未成水平直线；臂与扇骨未呈一直线

65.en: The spear/cudgel does not rotate in an obvious vertical plane

66.en: Weapon caught in a hugging manner; Failure to catch the straight sword/broadsword by the handle; the cudgel/spear shaft with a single hand; Failure to catch the fan by the bottom/handle with a single hand
66.zh: 抱接器械；未单手接握剑柄、刀柄、枪身、棍身；未单手接握扇骨底部

67.en: The end of the cudgel handle is not planted firmly on the ground; The tip of the cudgel is below the athlete's head level
67.zh: 把端未拄地；梢端低于头

68.en: Tip of the straight sword not travelling in a clearly- defined vertical circle
68.zh: 剑尖绕环未明显呈立圆

73.en: Weapon unintentionally makes contact with the floor; Loss of grip; Weapon strikes the body; Weapon deforms; Fan surface is detached from fan's ribs
73.zh: 器械触地、脱把、碰身、变形，扇面与扇骨脱离

74.en: Weapon Broken; Main or minor ribs of the fan breaks, nails on the ribs falls off/detached
74.zh: 器械折断；扇大骨或扇小骨折断、扇钉脱落

76.en: Broad Sword Ribbon; Straight sword Tassel; Spear Tassel; Garment Item; Headwear dropped on the floor; Broad Sword Ribbon; Straight sword Tassel; Soft Weapon entangles hand or body; Costume torn or button opened up; Shoes dropped off
76.zh: 刀彩、剑穗、枪缨、服饰、头饰掉地；刀彩、剑穗、软器械缠手（缠身）；服装开纽或撕裂；鞋脱落

77.en: Balance technique not completed rhythmically and quickly according to the characteristics of the event; Balance technique not maintained for at least 2 seconds
77.zh: 平衡动作未按项目特点有节奏快速完成；平衡动作静止时间不足2秒钟

80.en: For each missing/altering compulsory/mandatory technique in optional routines; For each missing/additional/altering compulsory/mandatory technique in compulsory routines
80.zh: 自选套路：每减少或改变一个规定动作；规定套路：每增加、减少或改变一个规定动作

81.en: Compulsory Routines: Missing or additional step
81.zh: 规定套路：每增加或减少一步

82.en: Nanquan, Nandao, Nangun Compulsory Routines: For each missing or additional vocalization or did not vocalize in accordance with the requirement
82.zh: 南拳、南刀、南棍规定套路：未按规定发声或每增加或减少一次发声

83.en: A static state (excluding balance techniques) which is held for longer than 2 seconds; During Taijiquan or Taijijian there is an obvious unmethodical pause prior to the execution of Degree of Difficulty technique; Performing non-offensive or non-defensive actions that disrupts the routine's rhythm before executing the Degree of Difficulty techniques
83.zh: 静止姿势（平衡动作除外）停顿时间超过2秒；太极拳、太极剑难度动作前出现停顿；难度动作前出现影响套路节奏的无攻防动作演练

84.en: For Changquan type and Nanquan Type events (including weapon routines), movements done in averted directions exceeding 90 degrees; For Taijiquan and Taijijian events, movements done in averted directions exceeding 45 degrees
84.zh: 长拳、南拳及其器械动作每偏向超过90°；太极拳、太极剑、太极扇动作每偏向超过45°

85.en: Between 2 groups of Degree of Difficulty techniques, there are less than 2 complete technique movements
85.zh: 两组难度之间少于两个完整的技术动作

86.en: Events Requiring Musical Accompaniment: No music or music which includes vocals/lyrics
86.zh: 要求配乐的项目未配乐或配乐伴有说唱

90.en: Attack goes wide or off target area; Footwork/Stance, Leg Technique not meeting the requirements; Jumping technique, Tumbling Technique not meeting the requirements; Weapon Technique not meeting the requirements
90.zh: 远离或偏离进攻部位；步型、腿法动作与要求不符；跳跃、跌扑动作与要求不符；器械方法与要求不符

91.en: Motionless state held for more than 3 seconds; Jumping technique, Tumbling Technique not meeting the requirements
91.zh: 静止姿势超过3秒钟；跳跃、跌扑动作与要求不符

92.en: Duration without attack and defense exceeds 3 seconds; Weapon Technique not meeting the requirements
92.zh: 无攻防演练超过3秒钟；器械方法与要求不符

93.en: Misses in attack or defense; Misses in attack or defense during sparring content
93.zh: 击打落空或防守落空；对练时击打落空或防守落空

94.en: Waiting for partner to attack; Waiting for partner to attack during sparring content
94.zh: 等待对方进攻；对练时等待对方进攻

95.en: Mishit on Partner/s; Mishit on Partner/s during sparring content
95.zh: 误中对方；对练时误中对方
